result.summary: The image shows a wide commercial intersection with multi-lane traffic and marked crosswalks on some legs. While sidewalks and curb ramps are present, the lack of pedestrian refuge islands and visible pedestrian signals increases risk for those crossing the wide main thoroughfare.

hazards.name: Long Crossing Distance
hazards.description: Pedestrians must cross multiple lanes of traffic without a refuge island, increasing exposure time.
hazards.location_in_image: Across the main roadway in the center of the image.

hazards.name: Visual Obstruction
hazards.description: Parked vehicles near the intersection corners may obstruct sightlines between drivers and pedestrians.
hazards.location_in_image: White truck parked on the left corner.

interventions.title: Pedestrian Refuge Island
interventions.description: Install a raised median or refuge island to allow pedestrians to cross one direction of traffic at a time.

interventions.title: Curb Extensions
interventions.description: Extend the sidewalk into the parking lane to shorten crossing distance and improve visibility.

result.summary: A signalized intersection with high-visibility crosswalks and sidewalks on both sides. The area features a mix of commercial and residential land uses with mature trees lining the side street.

hazards.name: Parked vehicle sightline obstruction
hazards.description: Vehicles parked close to the crosswalk on the side street may block the view of pedestrians for approaching drivers.
hazards.location_in_image: Right side of the image along the side street.

interventions.title: Curb Extensions
interventions.description: Install curb extensions to shorten the crossing distance and improve visibility between pedestrians and drivers.

interventions.title: Daylighting
interventions.description: Remove parking spaces immediately adjacent to the crosswalk to improve sightlines.

result.summary: The intersection is equipped with high-visibility continental crosswalks, pedestrian signals, and curb ramps. However, the wide four-lane roadway creates a long crossing distance for pedestrians without the protection of a median refuge island.

hazards.name: Long Crossing Distance
hazards.description: Pedestrians are exposed to multiple lanes of traffic over a long distance without a mid-point refuge.
hazards.location_in_image: Foreground crossing across the multi-lane road.

interventions.title: Pedestrian Refuge Island
interventions.description: Install a raised median island to provide a safe waiting area and allow pedestrians to cross one direction of traffic at a time.

interventions.title: Curb Extensions
interventions.description: Construct bulb-outs at the corners to reduce the crossing distance and increase pedestrian visibility to drivers.

result.summary: The intersection features high-visibility continental crosswalks and curb ramps, providing basic pedestrian infrastructure. However, the wide roadway and degraded pavement surface increase exposure and tripping risks, and dedicated pedestrian signals are not clearly visible.

hazards.name: Long crossing distance
hazards.description: The wide intersection increases the time pedestrians are exposed to vehicle traffic without a refuge.
hazards.location_in_image: Across the main roadway in the foreground

hazards.name: Degraded pavement
hazards.description: Visible cracks and uneven surfaces within the crosswalk area present a potential tripping hazard.
hazards.location_in_image: Foreground intersection area and crosswalk markings

interventions.title: Curb Extensions
interventions.description: Install bulb-outs to shorten the crossing distance and improve visibility between drivers and pedestrians.

interventions.title: Pedestrian Countdown Signals
interventions.description: Install dedicated pedestrian signals with countdown timers to improve clarity on crossing time.

interventions.title: Pavement Resurfacing
interventions.description: Repair the cracked roadway surface to ensure a smooth and safe walking path for all users.
